title: Hide --cpu-rt-period/--cpu-rt-runtime and mark them as NOP
body:
Implements the 6.x scope agreed in #29750: since Podman 6 dropped cgroups v1 support, the `--cpu-rt-period` and `--cpu-rt-runtime` options can never take effect (the real-time scheduler cgroup settings only exist on cgroups v1). Full removal is deferred to Podman 7.0; this PR does the interim step @Luap99 outlined:

- Remove the option documentation (`docs/source/markdown/options/cpu-rt-period.md`, `cpu-rt-runtime.md`) and drop the `@@option` references from the podman-create, podman-run, podman-update and podman-container-clone man pages (including the leftover clone sentence)
- Hide both flags from `--help` output (empty help text since the flags are hidden)
- Change the existing cgroups v2 warning to state the option is a NOP, the value is ignored, and the option will be removed in the next major release
- Update the e2e tests to match the new warning text

Actual removal of the flags and spec plumbing is left for 7.0, marked with `// TODO (7.0):` comments.

Verification note: developed on macOS, so I could not run `make podman`/e2e locally. Verified with `GOOS=linux go build`/`go vet` on the changed packages and `gofmt`; relying on CI for the full build and e2e run.

Part of #29750 (full flag removal remains for 7.0)

#### Does this PR introduce a user-facing change?

```release-note
The deprecated `--cpu-rt-period` and `--cpu-rt-runtime` options for `podman create`, `podman run`, `podman update`, and `podman container clone` are now hidden and undocumented. They are a NOP (the values are ignored, as they require cgroups v1 which is no longer supported) and will be removed in the next major release.
```
